palette.why: Warm clinic cream and spruce ground make the film cautiously hopeful. Berry red belongs only to projected, preliminary and wrong-test states. Gold appears only on facts already established by a source. All unearned criteria stay neutral graphite and unfilled. This avoids the prior glacier's charcoal, alpenglow amber, radar magenta and glacial cyan as well as the subsea film's dark marine chartreuse world.

light.direction: soft upper left key with a low warm bounce from the ground
light.key_fill_rim: broad cream key, restrained spruce fill, persistent plum lower-right edge on the cooler and gold rim only for established facts
light.depth: three paper and terrain planes separate through cast shadows, parallax and darker plum occlusion rather than blue haze
light.why: The story is a practical test, so readable daylight and grounded shadows beat science-noir or futuristic neon.

shape_language.grammar: The rounded insulated FlightCrate represents the human-scale goal. Hard rectangular award sheets, split lanes and approval gates represent the proof burden. Curved route ribbons become straight only when a criterion is named.
shape_language.why: Soft care object versus hard evidence geometry keeps hope and accountability visible at once.

casting.hero: FlightCrate, a net-new reusable cold-chain throughline asset with a tamper seal, thermometer, destination tag and five proof lights
supporting: BushPlane from vehicles.tsx for the existing conventional network
StatCard and Nameplate from props.tsx for the preliminary award
AlaskaMini from kit.tsx for the route field
Gate from civics.tsx for AIRCRAFT, PILOT and OPERATION proof states
casting.why: The crate is the one physical object every proposed system exists to move. Existing shelf assets cover people, conventional aviation, maps and paperwork.

motion_language.world: A route ribbon travels horizontally until hard gates stop it. Paper tears vertically when one award splits into two tests. The crate carries across every act boundary with spring anticipation and a weighted settle.
hero_moves: road rolls away by three seconds
crate pivots between conflicting geography cards at sixty seconds
five proof lights chase but remain graphite outlines near one hundred seconds
cargo ticket punches WRONG TEST before the final route payoff
motion_language.blur: 180-degree blur only on the road roll, the award split and the rejected ticket. The crate itself moves with readable mass.
motion_language.why: The film should feel like forward progress repeatedly checked by evidence, not a drone glamour reel.

composition.staging: Track left to right with the crate fixed near the center third while the world changes behind it. Use macro inserts for the cold gauge and document fields, an extreme-wide route map, then a two-up split for cargo and passenger proof. Keep all load-bearing action inside the central 1080 by 1080 crop.
composition.focal_hierarchy: FlightCrate first, one large claim plate second, route or aircraft silhouette third. Never stack more than one checklist behind captions.
composition.negative_space: At the turn, both aircraft shadows drop away and the crate waits in cream space with five outlined, unfilled proof lights.
composition.square_safe: The crate, award amount, route blank and wrong-test punch remain between y 470 and 1260 so the centered square preserves the argument.
composition.signature_shot: One pale medicine crate centers a single vertical tear. A short left rail reads CARGO TEST and a three-gate right stack reads PEOPLE TEST. All nuance stays in the voice so the square image remains immediate.
composition.why: The stable crate lets radical stage changes remain coherent and makes the two tests readable on phone and square.

craft_advance.change: A reusable anticipation, overshoot and settle primitive will drive proof lights and approval stamps so evidence states arrive with physical weight instead of linear opacity.
craft_advance.verification: TypeScript compile plus a FlightCrate look-development strip will verify PROPOSED, split-test, five-unearned-lights and blank-tag states at full size, 0.28 scale and centered-square crop. The strip must show the seal, gauge, tag, lights, shadows and cooler contrast against both paper and sky.
craft_advance.why: Approval and evidence stories recur, and their most important state changes should never look like flat HUD toggles.
